turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls with Laura.

turns.text: Show me the calls I have with Sam.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find all calls with Sam.

turns.text: Please return how many there are.
turns.rephrase: I mean: count how many there are and return the count.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE proc_57(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: proc_57
